name: Deep Analysis Notes
description: An advanced template focusing on unresolved questions, risks, blockers, agenda coverage, and active speaker mapping.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a detailed executive summary of the meeting, highlighting the main objectives, discussion points, and overall outcomes.

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: List the key decisions made during the meeting, noting any rationale or consensus reached.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List all assigned tasks with their owners, deadlines, and a reference transcript snippet/timestamp if possible.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List questions asked during the meeting that remained unanswered, required further research, or require follow-up validation.

sections.title: Risks & Blockers
sections.instruction: Identify and list any technical risks, bottlenecks, potential blockers, or warnings discussed during the meeting.

sections.title: Agenda vs. Realized
sections.instruction: Analyze if the planned agenda was fully addressed, noting any skipped items or new/unplanned topics introduced.

sections.title: Active Attendees
sections.instruction: List each speaker (e.g. Speaker 0, Speaker 1 or named speaker) who spoke during the meeting, and provide a 1-sentence summary of their primary contribution/focus.
